name: YouVersion Bible
description: Look up a passage in the licensed Bibles YouVersion offers (NIV, NASB, AMP and many more) and add it to the schedule. Passages one chapter at a time; whole Bibles and books are never downloaded. You use your own free YouVersion Platform key, kept in your computer's secure storage.

permissions.reason: Appears as a panel in the Bible library
The server asks the YouVersion Platform for the list of Bibles and for the passage you look up, using your key, and contacts no other host
Keeps your YouVersion Platform App Key in secure storage that only this plugin can read
Saves the passage you choose to add (one chapter or part of one) in your Bible library so it can be scheduled and shown. It can replace a saved passage of the same book, chapter, verses and version
Adds the passage you chose to the schedule
